::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Sept 8th 1892  
**From:** Elderfield Otterbourne Winchester  
**Manuscript:** MS Women’s Library, London Metropolitan University,  7MHE/3/1
:::

Dear [Madam](people/person_1895.qmd)
I am much obliged for your letter. I will try to write the article you wish, but I should like to know how soon you would wish it to be sent in

Yours truly
C M Yonge
